me.timeline_2019_desc: Led the commercial strategy and initial product discovery. We provided architectural services using immersive technology to disrupt the construction and design industry, establishing the core business model and validating market demand.
me.timeline_2020_desc: Productized the 3D visualization division. Hired and structured the initial design team, establishing aesthetic curation, standardizing delivery processes, and scaling output.

me.timeline_2022_desc: Directed product innovation and R&D. Bridged commercial strategy with technical execution to launch industry-first spatial computing products.
me.timeline_2022_highlight_1: Launched Colombia's first Augmented Reality (AR) furniture application.
me.timeline_2022_highlight_2: Launched pioneering Virtual Reality (VR) experiences for retail.
me.timeline_2023_desc: Designed and integrated tech-enabled physical retail experiences. Managed the complete product lifecycle for new digital tools that connected in-store users with broader digital ecosystems.
me.timeline_2024_desc: Expanded the product portfolio into new industry verticals (fashion, cosmetics). Adapted core software offerings to solve distinct user problems in adjacent consumer markets.
me.timeline_2025_desc: Authored and led the company-wide strategic pivot from a traditional agency model to a Product-Led Growth (PLG) organization. Architected the transformation framework for scalable software products.
me.timeline_2026_desc: Successfully managed a portfolio of 4 proprietary SaaS products. Optimized P&L, reduced churn, and achieved top-tier national recognition through operational and product excellence.
me.timeline_2026_highlight_1: Consolidated 4 software products under a unified SaaS model.

verbal.title: 04 / Verbal Identity
verbal.elevator: Juan Manuel Montoya is a Phygital Design Engineer. He architects and executes brand ecosystems across physical dimensions (retail, spaces) and digital realms (product, software). Instead of hiring a fragmented team of agencies, founders get one strategic mind that engineers the complete customer journey.
verbal.tone: Direct, surgical, ambitious, and deeply grounded in craft.

amplify.hero: Technology applied to products, services, and operations — for companies that want to grow with purpose.
amplify.intro:
Most companies have something good on their hands. What they don't have is someone who sees how to amplify it with technology.

That's what I do.
amplify.how_text:
I study the business from the inside. I understand the product, the service, the operation. I find the points where technology can multiply what is already working — not as a trend, but based on evidence.

Then I design and build the complete system. Software, hardware, integration. Everything connected as a single piece.
amplify.when_text:
To amplify what exists. Products that can sell better with tech. Services that can scale. Operations that can be smarter.

To build from scratch. Platforms, SaaS, digital tools. When there's a clear market intuition and you need someone to make it real.
amplify.deliver_text: Working systems. Not strategy, not presentations, not roadmaps. Technology that is already working for your business.
amplify.closing: A single person behind the entire system. Not ten vendors talking to each other.

echo.hero: Marketing campaigns that live across all channels as a single system.
echo.intro:
A campaign is not an ad. It is a system.

Most brands pay different agencies for each channel. Each tells its own version. The end customer receives noise.
echo.how_text:
I design campaigns that start in digital and move to every point where your brand touches the customer — social, physical, email, space, product. The story is the same. What changes is the form.

I adapt the language to each channel without losing the voice. I optimize resources by design, not by accident.
echo.when_text: For product launches that need to reach multiple audiences. For brand campaigns that must live in several channels at the same time. For moments when a brand needs to say one thing, loudly, everywhere.
echo.deliver_text: One campaign, several echoes, a single customer at the end. Complete system — concept, execution, distribution, measurement.
echo.closing: Not multi-channel by checklist. Multi-channel with criterion.

stage.hero: Physical experiences with technology — booths, launches, installations, and activations.
stage.intro:
Physical moments are still where brands stick in the memory.

A launch. A trade show. A showroom. An activation. Those are the spaces where people truly meet a brand — or where they forget it in five minutes.
stage.how_text:
I design and build those moments by integrating technology. Not technology as a trend. Not screens for the sake of screens. Technology that makes the experience feel different from everything that already exists.

I work on the physical space, the digital interactions that live within it, and the consistency with the rest of your brand. A system, not a decoration.
stage.when_text: Product launches. Trade show booths. Pop-ups and activations. Interactive installations. Experiential showrooms. Bold brand events.
stage.deliver_text: Built spaces, ready to operate. Integrated hardware. Running software. An experience that feels like a single piece, not an assembled event.
stage.closing: The difference between just another event and a moment people retell.
